<h4>Synchronisation, Reentranz und Task-Kontexte</h4>
<p>Die eigentliche Abarbeitung eingereihter Aufträge erfolgt strikt serialisiert im Kontext zyklischer Hauptfunktionen: <code>NvM_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00155" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00155">[SWS_NvM_00155]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00256" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00256">[SWS_NvM_00256]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00464" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00464">[SWS_NvM_00464]</a>, <code>Fee_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00097" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00097">[SWS_Fee_00097]</a> und <code>Ea_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00096" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00096">[SWS_Ea_00096]</a>. Zur Kopplung an das Betriebssystem nutzt der <code>NvM</code> ausschließlich den BSW-Scheduler (SchM) anstelle direkter OS-Objekte <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00332" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00332">[SWS_NvM_00332]</a>. Die APIs der Module sind nicht reentrant ausgelegt (z. B. <code>NvM_Init</code>, <code>NvM_ReadAll</code>, <code>NvM_WriteAll</code>, <code>Fee_Init</code>, <code>Ea_Init</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00447" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00447">[SWS_NvM_00447]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00458" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00458">[SWS_NvM_00458]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00460" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00460">[SWS_NvM_00460]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00461" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00461">[SWS_NvM_00461]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00038" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00038">[SWS_MemIf_00038]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00085" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00085">[SWS_Fee_00085]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00084" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00084">[SWS_Ea_00084]</a>.</p>
<p>Wenn prioritätsbasierte Auftragsverarbeitung aktiviert ist (<code>NvMJobPrioritization == TRUE</code>), führt der <code>NvM</code> zwei separate Queues: eine Immediate-Queue für zeitkritische Schreibaufträge mit höchster Priorität (z. B. Crash-Daten) und eine Standard-Queue für reguläre Aufträge <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00032" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00032">[SWS_NvM_00032]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00259" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00259">[SWS_NvM_00259]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00378" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00378">[SWS_NvM_00378]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00564" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00564">[SWS_NvM_00564]</a>. Immediate-Schreibaufträge können laufende asynchrone Aufträge unterbrechen; der unterbrochene Auftrag wird nach Abschluss des Sofortauftrags vom <code>NvM</code> wiederaufgenommen oder neu gestartet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00182" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00182">[SWS_NvM_00182]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00258" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00258">[SWS_NvM_00258]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00300" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00300">[SWS_NvM_00300]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00570" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00570">[SWS_NvM_00570]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00800" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00800">[SWS_NvM_00800]</a>. Für Immediate-Blöcke ist typischerweise keine CRC konfiguriert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00721" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00721">[SWS_NvM_00721]</a>. Ist die Priorisierung deaktiviert, werden alle Aufträge rein sequenziell nach FIFO verarbeitet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00379" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00379">[SWS_NvM_00379]</a>.</p>
<p>Die Synchronisation zwischen <code>NvM</code> und der unteren Abstraktionsschicht wird über Polling oder Callbacks realisiert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00346" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00346">[SWS_NvM_00346]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00438" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00438">[SWS_NvM_00438]</a>. Bei deaktiviertem Polling melden <code>Fee</code> und <code>Ea</code> den Abschluss einer Hardwareoperation über <code>NvM_JobEndNotification</code> bzw. <code>NvM_JobErrorNotification</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00111" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00111">[SWS_NvM_00111]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00440" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00440">[SWS_NvM_00440]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00441" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00441">[SWS_NvM_00441]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00098" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00098">[SWS_Fee_00098]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00099" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00099">[SWS_Fee_00099]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00099" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00099">[SWS_Ea_00099]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00100" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00100">[SWS_Ea_00100]</a>. Die Benachrichtigung der Anwendung nach Abschluss eines Einzelblockauftrags erfolgt optional über <code>NvMSingleBlockCallback</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00113" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00113">[SWS_NvM_00113]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00176" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00176">[SWS_NvM_00176]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00347" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00347">[SWS_NvM_00347]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00740" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00740">[SWS_NvM_00740]</a>. In Mehrkern- und partitionierten Systemen laufen globale Dienste wie <code>NvM_ReadAll</code> und <code>NvM_WriteAll</code> verbindlich auf der Master-Partition <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00969" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00969">[SWS_NvM_00969]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00970" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00970">[SWS_NvM_00970]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00971" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00971">[SWS_NvM_00971]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_CONSTR00974" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_CONSTR00974">[SWS_NvM_CONSTR00974]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_CONSTR00975" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_CONSTR00975">[SWS_NvM_CONSTR00975]</a>, während Einzelblöcke spezifischen Partitionen zugewiesen sein können <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_CONSTR00972" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_CONSTR00972">[SWS_NvM_CONSTR00972]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_CONSTR00973" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_CONSTR00973">[SWS_NvM_CONSTR00973]</a>.</p>

<h4>Typische Lebenszyklen und Betriebsmodi</h4>
<p>Beim Systemhochlauf (Startup) muss die Initialisierung der Speichertreiber (<code>Fls</code>, <code>Eep</code>) und der Abstraktionsmodule (<code>Fee_Init</code>, <code>Ea_Init</code>) abgeschlossen sein, bevor der BSW Mode Manager (<code>BswM</code>) exklusiv <code>NvM_Init</code> aufruft <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00157" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00157">[SWS_NvM_00157]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00193" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00193">[SWS_NvM_00193]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00693" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00693">[SWS_NvM_00693]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00085" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00085">[SWS_Fee_00085]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00084" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00084">[SWS_Ea_00084]</a>. Der Übergabeparameter <code>ConfigPtr</code> muss dabei stets <code>NULL_PTR</code> sein <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00880" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00880">[SWS_NvM_00880]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00881" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00881">[SWS_NvM_00881]</a>. <code>NvM_Init</code> setzt alle internen Zustandsvariablen, Queues und Flags zurück und initialisiert Dataset-Indizes auf null, liest jedoch aus Gründen der Startzeitoptimierung noch keine Datenblöcke aus dem NV-Speicher <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00091" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00091">[SWS_NvM_00091]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00192" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00192">[SWS_NvM_00192]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00257" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00257">[SWS_NvM_00257]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00399" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00399">[SWS_NvM_00399]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00400" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00400">[SWS_NvM_00400]</a>.</p>
<p>Das Einlesen und Validieren der permanenten RAM-Blöcke wird anschließend durch die Multiblock-Funktion <code>NvM_ReadAll</code> angestoßen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00118" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00118">[SWS_NvM_00118]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00158" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00158">[SWS_NvM_00158]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00243" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00243">[SWS_NvM_00243]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00356" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00356">[SWS_NvM_00356]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00718" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00718">[SWS_NvM_00718]</a>. Sofern <code>NvMDrvModeSwitch</code> konfiguriert ist, schaltet der <code>NvM</code> zu Beginn über <code>MemIf_SetMode</code> alle Speichergeräte in den Fast-Mode (<code>MEMIF_MODE_FAST</code>) und nach Abschluss zurück in den Slow-Mode (<code>MEMIF_MODE_SLOW</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00426" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00426">[SWS_NvM_00426]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00427" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00427">[SWS_NvM_00427]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00038" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00038">[SWS_MemIf_00038]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00066" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00066">[SWS_MemIf_00066]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00086" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00086">[SWS_Fee_00086]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00085" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00085">[SWS_Ea_00085]</a>. Als erster Schritt von <code>NvM_ReadAll</code> wird über Block ID 1 die gespeicherte Konfigurations-ID mit der kompilierten Software-Konfigurations-ID verglichen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00034" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00034">[SWS_NvM_00034]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00073" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00073">[SWS_NvM_00073]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00246" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00246">[SWS_NvM_00246]</a>. Bei einer Übereinstimmung erfolgt die normale Vorbereitung aller Blöcke <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00247" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00247">[SWS_NvM_00247]</a>; bei Abweichung und aktiver dynamischer Konfiguration (<code>NvMDynamicConfiguration == TRUE</code>) greift eine erweiterte Laufzeitvorbereitung zur Wiederherstellung von Standardwerten <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00248" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00248">[SWS_NvM_00248]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00249" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00249">[SWS_NvM_00249]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00309" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00309">[SWS_NvM_00309]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00310" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00310">[SWS_NvM_00310]</a>. Für fabrikneue Steuergeräte steht mit <code>NvM_FirstInitAll</code> ein Initialisierungsdienst bereit, der Blöcke mit Standardwerten beschreibt oder invalidiert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_91001" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_91001">[SWS_NvM_91001]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00913" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00913">[SWS_NvM_00913]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00916" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00916">[SWS_NvM_00916]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00923" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00923">[SWS_NvM_00923]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00931" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00931">[SWS_NvM_00931]</a>.</p>
<p>Beim Herunterfahren des Steuergeräts (Shutdown) stößt der <code>BswM</code> die Multiblock-Schreibfunktion <code>NvM_WriteAll</code> an <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00018" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00018">[SWS_NvM_00018]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00092" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00092">[SWS_NvM_00092]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00254" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00254">[SWS_NvM_00254]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00720" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00720">[SWS_NvM_00720]</a>. <code>NvM_WriteAll</code> schaltet die Speichergeräte bei Bedarf erneut in den Fast-Mode <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00430" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00430">[SWS_NvM_00430]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00431" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00431">[SWS_NvM_00431]</a> und synchronisiert alle permanenten RAM-Blöcke oder RAM-Spiegel, die als gültig und verändert (valid/changed) markiert sind, mit den korrespondierenden NV-Blöcken <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00252" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00252">[SWS_NvM_00252]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00472" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00472">[SWS_NvM_00472]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00682" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00682">[SWS_NvM_00682]</a>. Schreibgeschützte oder gesperrte Blöcke werden ohne Fehler übersprungen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00434" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00434">[SWS_NvM_00434]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00750" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00750">[SWS_NvM_00750]</a>. Soll das Herunterfahren abgebrochen werden, ruft der <code>BswM</code> <code>NvM_CancelWriteAll</code> auf, wodurch der aktuell geschriebene Block konsistent beendet und nachfolgende Blöcke als <code>NVM_REQ_CANCELED</code> markiert werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00019" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00019">[SWS_NvM_00019]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00232" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00232">[SWS_NvM_00232]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00236" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00236">[SWS_NvM_00236]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00238" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00238">[SWS_NvM_00238]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00703" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00703">[SWS_NvM_00703]</a>. Statusübergänge von Multiblock- und Einzelblockoperationen werden dem <code>BswM</code> über <code>BswM_NvM_CurrentJobMode()</code> und <code>BswM_NvM_CurrentBlockMode()</code> gemeldet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00745" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00745">[SWS_NvM_00745]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00746" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00746">[SWS_NvM_00746]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00888" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00888">[SWS_NvM_00888]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00889" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00889">[SWS_NvM_00889]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00890" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00890">[SWS_NvM_00890]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00891" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00891">[SWS_NvM_00891]</a>.</p>

<h4>Fehlerbehandlung, Det-Tracing und Degradation</h4>
<p>Zur Erkennung von Dateninkonsistenzen nutzt der Cluster mehrstufige Integritätsmechanismen. Für NV- und RAM-Blöcke können CRC-Prüfsummen konfiguriert werden, die über das Modul <code>Crc</code> in Einzelschritten innerhalb der <code>NvM_MainFunction</code> berechnet werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00040" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00040">[SWS_NvM_00040]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00164" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00164">[SWS_NvM_00164]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00165" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00165">[SWS_NvM_00165]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00180" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00180">[SWS_NvM_00180]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00212" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00212">[SWS_NvM_00212]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00333" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00333">[SWS_NvM_00333]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00334" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00334">[SWS_NvM_00334]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00466" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00466">[SWS_NvM_00466]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00571" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00571">[SWS_NvM_00571]</a>. Beim Lesen wird die CRC geprüft; bei aktiviertem Static Block ID Header wird zusätzlich geprüft, ob die gelesene Block-ID mit der angeforderten übereinstimmt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00523" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00523">[SWS_NvM_00523]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00524" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00524">[SWS_NvM_00524]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00580" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00580">[SWS_NvM_00580]</a>. Um Flash-Schreibzyklen zu minimieren, kann über <code>NvMBlockUseCRCCompMechanism</code> ein CRC-basierter Schreibvergleich aktiviert werden, der das Schreiben unveränderter Daten überspringt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00849" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00849">[SWS_NvM_00849]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00850" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00850">[SWS_NvM_00850]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00853" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00853">[SWS_NvM_00853]</a>.</p>
<p>Bei Schreibfehlern führt der <code>NvM</code> automatische Wiederholversuche bis zur konfigurierten Grenze <code>NVM_MAX_NUM_OF_WRITE_RETRIES</code> durch <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00168" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00168">[SWS_NvM_00168]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00213" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00213">[SWS_NvM_00213]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00216" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00216">[SWS_NvM_00216]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00296" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00296">[SWS_NvM_00296]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00659" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00659">[SWS_NvM_00659]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00804" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00804">[SWS_NvM_00804]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00806" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00806">[SWS_NvM_00806]</a>. Nach erfolgreichem Schreiben kann optional ein schrittweiser Rücklese- und Verifikationsprozess stattfinden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00527" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00527">[SWS_NvM_00527]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00529" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00529">[SWS_NvM_00529]</a>. Bei Lesefehlern eines redundanten Blocks (z. B. CRC-Fehler oder Header-Fehler auf der ersten Instanz) liest der <code>NvM</code> automatisch die zweite NV-Kopie ein und stellt die verloren gegangene Redundanz wieder her <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00047" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00047">[SWS_NvM_00047]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00199" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00199">[SWS_NvM_00199]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00288" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00288">[SWS_NvM_00288]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00474" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00474">[SWS_NvM_00474]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00531" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00531">[SWS_NvM_00531]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00768" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00768">[SWS_NvM_00768]</a>. Schlagen alle NV-Leseversuche fehl, greift die Fehlerdegradation: Sofern konfiguriert, werden Standardwerte aus dem ROM-Block oder über den Callback <code>NvMInitBlockCallback</code> in das RAM geladen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00012" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00012">[SWS_NvM_00012]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00020" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00020">[SWS_NvM_00020]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00171" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00171">[SWS_NvM_00171]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00202" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00202">[SWS_NvM_00202]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00267" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00267">[SWS_NvM_00267]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00293" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00293">[SWS_NvM_00293]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00366" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00366">[SWS_NvM_00366]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00367" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00367">[SWS_NvM_00367]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00369" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00369">[SWS_NvM_00369]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00389" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00389">[SWS_NvM_00389]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00657" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00657">[SWS_NvM_00657]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00679" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00679">[SWS_NvM_00679]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00814" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00814">[SWS_NvM_00814]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00816" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00816">[SWS_NvM_00816]</a>. Existieren keine Standardwerte, bleibt der RAM-Block im Zustand <code>invalid</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00132" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00132">[SWS_NvM_00132]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00133" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00133">[SWS_NvM_00133]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00198" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00198">[SWS_NvM_00198]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00658" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00658">[SWS_NvM_00658]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00680" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00680">[SWS_NvM_00680]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00767" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00767">[SWS_NvM_00767]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00788" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00788">[SWS_NvM_00788]</a>.</p>
<p>Fehlersituationen werden an das Diagnostic Event Manager (<code>Dem</code>) und Default Error Tracer (<code>Det</code>) gemeldet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00446" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00446">[SWS_NvM_00446]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00554" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00554">[SWS_NvM_00554]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00048" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00048">[SWS_MemIf_00048]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00104" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00104">[SWS_Fee_00104]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00098" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00098">[SWS_Ea_00098]</a>. Der <code>NvM</code> meldet definierte Produktionsfehler an das <code>Dem</code>: <code>NVM_E_INTEGRITY_FAILED</code> bei CRC-Fehlern oder <code>MEMIF_BLOCK_INCONSISTENT</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00203" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00203">[SWS_NvM_00203]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00294" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00294">[SWS_NvM_00294]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00653" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00653">[SWS_NvM_00653]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00677" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00677">[SWS_NvM_00677]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00779" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00779">[SWS_NvM_00779]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00790" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00790">[SWS_NvM_00790]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00864" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00864">[SWS_NvM_00864]</a>, <code>NVM_E_REQ_FAILED</code> bei Fehlschlagen von Aufträgen oder abgelaufenen Retries <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00302" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00302">[SWS_NvM_00302]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00305" The original reference version is shown below.</div> <h4>Systemarchitektur und Rolle des Modulclusters Memory Services</h4> <p>Der Modulcluster <em>Memory Services</em> der AUTOSAR Classic Platform stellt die standardisierte Verwaltung und Abstraktion nichtflüchtiger Daten für Anwendungs-Softwarekomponenten und Basissoftware-Module (BSW) bereit. Der Cluster umfasst den NVRAM Manager (<code>NvM</code>) auf der BSW-Dienstschicht (Service Layer) sowie die Schnittstellen- und Abstraktionsmodule Memory Abstraction Interface (<code>MemIf</code>), Flash EEPROM Emulation (<code>Fee</code>) und EEPROM Abstraction (<code>Ea</code>) auf der Hardware-Abstraktionsschicht <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00051" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00051">[SWS_NvM_00051]</a>. Zweck dieses Schichtenverbunds ist es, obere Softwareschichten vollständig von den physikalischen Eigenschaften und Speichertechnologien der zugrunde liegenden Speicherbausteine (z. B. On-Chip- bzw. externes Flash über den <code>Fls</code>-Treiber oder EEPROM über den <code>Eep</code>-Treiber) zu entkoppeln <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00084" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00084">[SWS_Fee_00084]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00083" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00083">[SWS_Ea_00083]</a>. Hierzu spannen <code>MemIf</code>, <code>Fee</code> und <code>Ea</code> für den <code>NvM</code> einen virtuellen, linearen 32-Bit-Adressraum auf <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00051" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00051">[SWS_NvM_00051]</a>.</p> <p>Zentrales Strukturierungselement des Speicherclusters ist der NVRAM-Block, der bei der Konfiguration über Deskriptoren verbindlich definiert wird <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00030" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00030">[SWS_NvM_00030]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00140" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00140">[SWS_NvM_00140]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00143" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00143">[SWS_NvM_00143]</a>. Ein NVRAM-Block setzt sich stets aus den obligatorischen Speicherobjekten NV-Block, RAM-Block und Administrativer Block zusammen; optional kann ein ROM-Block für Standardwerte hinzukommen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00138" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00138">[SWS_NvM_00138]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00139" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00139">[SWS_NvM_00139]</a>. Der NV-Block repräsentiert die Daten im nichtflüchtigen Speicher inklusive optionaler Prüfsumme (CRC) und statischem Block-Header <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00125" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00125">[SWS_NvM_00125]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00522" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00522">[SWS_NvM_00522]</a>. Der RAM-Block hält das flüchtige Abbild für den schnellen Datenzugriff der Anwendung <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00126" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00126">[SWS_NvM_00126]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00130" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00130">[SWS_NvM_00130]</a>. Der rein im RAM lokalisierte Administrative Block ist für die Anwendung unsichtbar und speichert Steuer- und Statusattribute wie Blockindizes, Schreibschutz-Flags sowie den Fehler- und Auftragsstatus <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00054" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00054">[SWS_NvM_00054]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00134" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00134">[SWS_NvM_00134]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00135" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00135">[SWS_NvM_00135]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00136" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00136">[SWS_NvM_00136]</a>.</p> <p>Der Cluster unterstützt drei standardisierte NVRAM-Speichertypen: <code>NVM_BLOCK_NATIVE</code> (bestehend aus einem NV-Block, einem RAM-Block und einem Administrativen Block) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00000" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00000">[SWS_NvM_00000]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00557" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00557">[SWS_NvM_00557]</a>, <code>NVM_BLOCK_REDUNDANT</code> (bestehend aus zwei identischen NV-Blöcken zur Fehlertoleranz, einem RAM-Block und einem Administrativen Block) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00001" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00001">[SWS_NvM_00001]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00558" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00558">[SWS_NvM_00558]</a> sowie <code>NVM_BLOCK_DATASET</code> (bestehend aus mehreren NV-Blöcken bzw. optionalen ROM-Blöcken, einem RAM-Block und einem Administrativen Block) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00006" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00006">[SWS_NvM_00006]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00137" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00137">[SWS_NvM_00137]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00559" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00559">[SWS_NvM_00559]</a>. Um Ressourcen zu schonen, kann der Funktionsumfang über drei API-Konfigurationsklassen (Klasse 1 bis 3) skaliert werden, wobei beispielsweise Dataset-Blöcke in Klasse 1 nicht unterstützt werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00149" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00149">[SWS_NvM_00149]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00150" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00150">[SWS_NvM_00150]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00365" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00365">[SWS_NvM_00365]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00560" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00560">[SWS_NvM_00560]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00561" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00561">[SWS_NvM_00561]</a>.</p> <div class="diagram" id="diag-mem-arch"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" 95.5,-47.77 102.5,-47.77"></polygon> </g> </g> </svg></div> <p class="diagram-note">Kontextdiagramm: Schichtenarchitektur und Modulbeziehungen des Memory-Clusters. Quellen: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00051" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00051">[SWS_NvM_00051]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00039" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00039">[SWS_MemIf_00039]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00084" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00084">[SWS_Fee_00084]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00083" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00083">[SWS_Ea_00083]</a>.</p> <h4>Zusammenspiel und Interaktionspfade zwischen den Modulen</h4> <p>Softwarekomponenten und BSW-Module adressieren nichtflüchtigen Speicher ausschließlich über die logische Block-ID des <code>NvM</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00069" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00069">[SWS_NvM_00069]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00384" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00384">[SWS_NvM_00384]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00471" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00471">[SWS_NvM_00471]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00691" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00691">[SWS_NvM_00691]</a>. Ein direkter Zugriff oberer Schichten auf <code>MemIf</code>, <code>Fee</code> oder <code>Ea</code> ist unzulässig. Der <code>NvM</code> bildet die logische Block-ID auf die Blocknummer der Abstraktionsschicht ab, wobei die NV-Block-Basisnummer (<code>NVM_NV_BLOCK_BASE_NUMBER</code>) in den höchstwertigen Bits der Fee/Ea-Blocknummer hinterlegt wird <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00123" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00123">[SWS_NvM_00123]</a>. Bei redundanten Blöcken erfolgt die Adressierung gegenüber der Hardware-Abstraktion analog zu Dataset-Blöcken über aufeinanderfolgende Indizes <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00343" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00343">[SWS_NvM_00343]</a>.</p> <p>Das Modul <code>MemIf</code> fungiert als Multiplexer und leitet Zugriffe anhand des Geräteindex (<code>DeviceIndex</code>) transparent an die zuständige Instanz weiter: an <code>Fee</code> für Flash-Speicher oder an <code>Ea</code> für EEPROM-Bausteine <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00039" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00039">[SWS_MemIf_00039]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00040" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00040">[SWS_MemIf_00040]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00041" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00041">[SWS_MemIf_00041]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00044" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00044">[SWS_MemIf_00044]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00046" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00046">[SWS_MemIf_00046]</a>. Die Schnittstellen zwischen <code>MemIf</code> und <code>Fee</code> bzw. <code>Ea</code> sind syntaktisch homogen aufgebaut (<code>Fee_Read</code>, <code>Fee_Write</code>, <code>Fee_InvalidateBlock</code>, <code>Fee_EraseImmediateBlock</code>, <code>Fee_Cancel</code> bzw. deren Äquivalente in <code>Ea</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00087" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00087">[SWS_Fee_00087]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00088" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00088">[SWS_Fee_00088]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00089" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00089">[SWS_Fee_00089]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00092" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00092">[SWS_Fee_00092]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00094" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00094">[SWS_Fee_00094]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00086" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00086">[SWS_Ea_00086]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00087" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00087">[SWS_Ea_00087]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00088" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00088">[SWS_Ea_00088]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00091" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00091">[SWS_Ea_00091]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00093" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00093">[SWS_Ea_00093]</a>. <code>Fee</code> und <code>Ea</code> wiederum transformieren diese logischen Blockoperationen in Zugriffe auf die zugrunde liegenden Treiber <code>Fls</code> bzw. <code>Eep</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00084" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00084">[SWS_Fee_00084]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00187" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00187">[SWS_Fee_00187]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00083" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00083">[SWS_Ea_00083]</a>.</p> <p>Lese-, Schreib- und Kontrolloperationen an einzelnen Blöcken (z. B. <code>NvM_ReadBlock</code>, <code>NvM_WriteBlock</code>, <code>NvM_RestoreBlockDefaults</code>, <code>NvM_EraseNvBlock</code>, <code>NvM_InvalidateNvBlock</code>) werden vom <code>NvM</code> asynchron über interne Warteschlangen entgegengenommen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00162" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00162">[SWS_NvM_00162]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00181" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00181">[SWS_NvM_00181]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00195" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00195">[SWS_NvM_00195]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00208" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00208">[SWS_NvM_00208]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00224" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00224">[SWS_NvM_00224]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00231" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00231">[SWS_NvM_00231]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00239" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00239">[SWS_NvM_00239]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00385" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00385">[SWS_NvM_00385]</a>. Der Aufruf kehrt unmittelbar mit <code>E_OK</code> oder <code>E_NOT_OK</code> (bei voller Queue) zurück, während der Auftragsstatus im Administrativen Block auf <code>NVM_REQ_PENDING</code> gesetzt wird <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00184" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00184">[SWS_NvM_00184]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00185" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00185">[SWS_NvM_00185]</a>. Alternativ stehen dedizierte APIs für permanente RAM-Blöcke zur Verfügung (<code>NvM_ReadPRAMBlock</code>, <code>NvM_WritePRAMBlock</code>, <code>NvM_RestorePRAMBlockDefaults</code>), welche keinen Übergabepuffer erfordern <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00764" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00764">[SWS_NvM_00764]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00765" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00765">[SWS_NvM_00765]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00793" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00793">[SWS_NvM_00793]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00794" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00794">[SWS_NvM_00794]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00813" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00813">[SWS_NvM_00813]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00814" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00814">[SWS_NvM_00814]</a>.</p> <p>Für die Pufferverwaltung existieren zwei Synchronisationskonzepte: die implizite Synchronisation über permanent oder temporär zugewiesene Anwendungs-RAM-Puffer <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00038" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00038">[SWS_NvM_00038]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00088" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00088">[SWS_NvM_00088]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00129" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00129">[SWS_NvM_00129]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00278" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00278">[SWS_NvM_00278]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00280" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00280">[SWS_NvM_00280]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00698" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00698">[SWS_NvM_00698]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00699" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00699">[SWS_NvM_00699]</a> sowie die explizite Synchronisation über einen internen RAM-Spiegel (RAM Mirror) des <code>NvM</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00511" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00511">[SWS_NvM_00511]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00513" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00513">[SWS_NvM_00513]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00514" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00514">[SWS_NvM_00514]</a>. Ist die explizite Synchronisation konfiguriert (<code>NvMBlockUseSyncMech == TRUE</code>), besitzt der Block kein permanentes RAM-Abbild <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00904" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00904">[SWS_NvM_00904]</a>; der Datenaustausch erfolgt über Callbacks (<code>NvMWriteRamBlockToNvCallback</code> zum Kopieren in den Spiegel bzw. <code>NvMReadRamBlockFromNvCallback</code> zum Zurückschreiben) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00515" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00515">[SWS_NvM_00515]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00516" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00516">[SWS_NvM_00516]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00539" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00539">[SWS_NvM_00539]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00540" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00540">[SWS_NvM_00540]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00705" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00705">[SWS_NvM_00705]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00706" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00706">[SWS_NvM_00706]</a>. Optional können Daten vor der Weiterleitung an <code>MemIf</code> über den Crypto Service Manager verschlüsselt (<code>Csm_Encrypt</code>) oder nach dem Lesen entschlüsselt werden (<code>Csm_Decrypt</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00976" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00976">[SWS_NvM_00976]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00980" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00980">[SWS_NvM_00980]</a>.</p> <div class="diagram" id="diag-nvm-read-seq"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewbox="0 0 900 743" class="diagram-note">Sequenzdiagramm: Asynchroner Leseablauf vom Anwendungsaufruf bis zum Callback. Quellen: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00162" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00162">[SWS_NvM_00162]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00195" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00195">[SWS_NvM_00195]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00256" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00256">[SWS_NvM_00256]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00039" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00039">[SWS_MemIf_00039]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00087" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00087">[SWS_Fee_00087]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00098" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00098">[SWS_Fee_00098]</a>.</p> <h4>Synchronisation, Reentranz und Task-Kontexte</h4> <p>Die eigentliche Abarbeitung eingereihter Aufträge erfolgt strikt serialisiert im Kontext zyklischer Hauptfunktionen: <code>NvM_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00155" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00155">[SWS_NvM_00155]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00256" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00256">[SWS_NvM_00256]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00464" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00464">[SWS_NvM_00464]</a>, <code>Fee_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00097" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00097">[SWS_Fee_00097]</a> und <code>Ea_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00096" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00096">[SWS_Ea_00096]</a>. Zur Kopplung an das Betriebssystem nutzt der <code>NvM</code> ausschließlich den BSW-Scheduler (SchM) anstelle direkter OS-Objekte <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00332" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00332">[SWS_NvM_00332]</a>. Die APIs der Module sind nicht reentrant ausgelegt (z. B. <code>NvM_Init</code>, <code>NvM_ReadAll</code>, <code>NvM_WriteAll</code>, <code>Fee_Init</code>, <code>Ea_Init</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00447" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00447">[SWS_NvM_00447]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00458" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00458">[SWS_NvM_00458]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00460" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00460">[SWS_NvM_00460]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00461" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00461">[SWS_NvM_00461]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00038" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00038">[SWS_MemIf_00038]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00085" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00085">[SWS_Fee_00085]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00084" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00084">[SWS_Ea_00084]</a>.</p> <p>Wenn prioritätsbasierte Auftragsverarbeitung aktiviert ist (<code>NvMJobPrioritization == TRUE</code>), führt der <code>NvM</code> zwei separate Queues: eine Immediate-Queue für zeitkritische Schreibaufträge mit höchster Priorität (z. B. Crash-Daten) und eine Standard-Queue für reguläre Aufträge <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00032" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00032">[SWS_NvM_00032]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00259" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00259">[SWS_NvM_00259]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00378" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00378">[SWS_NvM_00378]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00564" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00564">[SWS_NvM_00564]</a>. Immediate-Schreibaufträge können laufende asynchrone Aufträge unterbrechen; der unterbrochene Auftrag wird nach Abschluss des Sofortauftrags vom <code>NvM</code> wiederaufgenommen oder neu gestartet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00182" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00182">[SWS_NvM_00182]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00258" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00258">[SWS_NvM_00258]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00300" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00300">[SWS_NvM_00300]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00570" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00570">[SWS_NvM_00570]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00800" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00800">[SWS_NvM_00800]</a>. Für Immediate-Blöcke ist typischerweise keine CRC konfiguriert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00721" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00721">[SWS_NvM_00721]</a>. Ist die Priorisierung deaktiviert, werden alle Aufträge rein sequenziell nach FIFO verarbeitet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00379" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00379">[SWS_NvM_00379]</a>.</p> <p>Die Synchronisation zwischen <code>NvM</code> und der unteren Abstraktionsschicht wird über Polling oder Callbacks realisiert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00346" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00346">[SWS_NvM_00346]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00438" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00438">[SWS_NvM_00438]</a>. Bei deaktiviertem Polling melden <code>Fee</code> und <code>Ea</code> den Abschluss einer Hardwareoperation über <code>NvM_JobEndNotification</code> bzw. <code>NvM_JobErrorNotification</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00111" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00111">[SWS_NvM_00111]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00440" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00440">[SWS_NvM_00440]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00441" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00441">[SWS_NvM_00441]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00098" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00098">[SWS_Fee_00098]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00099" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00099">[SWS_Fee_00099]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00099" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00099">[SWS_Ea_00099]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00100" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00100">[SWS_Ea_00100]</a>. Die Benachrichtigung der Anwendung nach Abschluss eines Einzelblockauftrags erfolgt optional über <code>NvMSingleBlockCallback</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00113" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00113">[SWS_NvM_00113]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00176" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00176">[SWS_NvM_00176]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00347" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00347">[SWS_NvM_00347]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00740" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00740">[SWS_NvM_00740]</a>. In Mehrkern- und partitionierten Systemen laufen globale Dienste wie <code>NvM_ReadAll</code> und <code>NvM_WriteAll</code> verbindlich auf der Master-Partition <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00969" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00969">[SWS_NvM_00969]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00970" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00970">[SWS_NvM_00970]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00971" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00971">[SWS_NvM_00971]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_CONSTR00974" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_CONSTR00974">[SWS_NvM_CONSTR00974]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_CONSTR00975" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_CONSTR00975">[SWS_NvM_CONSTR00975]</a>, während Einzelblöcke spezifischen Partitionen zugewiesen sein können <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_CONSTR00972" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_CONSTR00972">[SWS_NvM_CONSTR00972]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_CONSTR00973" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_CONSTR00973">[SWS_NvM_CONSTR00973]</a>.</p> <h4>Typische Lebenszyklen und Betriebsmodi</h4> <p>Beim Systemhochlauf (Startup) muss die Initialisierung der Speichertreiber (<code>Fls</code>, <code>Eep</code>) und der Abstraktionsmodule (<code>Fee_Init</code>, <code>Ea_Init</code>) abgeschlossen sein, bevor der BSW Mode Manager (<code>BswM</code>) exklusiv <code>NvM_Init</code> aufruft <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00157" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00157">[SWS_NvM_00157]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00193" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00193">[SWS_NvM_00193]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00693" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00693">[SWS_NvM_00693]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00085" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00085">[SWS_Fee_00085]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00084" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00084">[SWS_Ea_00084]</a>. Der Übergabeparameter <code>ConfigPtr</code> muss dabei stets <code>NULL_PTR</code> sein <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00880" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00880">[SWS_NvM_00880]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00881" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00881">[SWS_NvM_00881]</a>. <code>NvM_Init</code> setzt alle internen Zustandsvariablen, Queues und Flags zurück und initialisiert Dataset-Indizes auf null, liest jedoch aus Gründen der Startzeitoptimierung noch keine Datenblöcke aus dem NV-Speicher <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00091" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00091">[SWS_NvM_00091]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00192" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00192">[SWS_NvM_00192]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00257" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00257">[SWS_NvM_00257]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00399" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00399">[SWS_NvM_00399]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00400" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00400">[SWS_NvM_00400]</a>.</p> <p>Das Einlesen und Validieren der permanenten RAM-Blöcke wird anschließend durch die Multiblock-Funktion <code>NvM_ReadAll</code> angestoßen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00118" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00118">[SWS_NvM_00118]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00158" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00158">[SWS_NvM_00158]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00243" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00243">[SWS_NvM_00243]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00356" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00356">[SWS_NvM_00356]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00718" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00718">[SWS_NvM_00718]</a>. Sofern <code>NvMDrvModeSwitch</code> konfiguriert ist, schaltet der <code>NvM</code> zu Beginn über <code>MemIf_SetMode</code> alle Speichergeräte in den Fast-Mode (<code>MEMIF_MODE_FAST</code>) und nach Abschluss zurück in den Slow-Mode (<code>MEMIF_MODE_SLOW</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00426" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00426">[SWS_NvM_00426]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00427" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00427">[SWS_NvM_00427]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00038" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00038">[SWS_MemIf_00038]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00066" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00066">[SWS_MemIf_00066]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00086" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00086">[SWS_Fee_00086]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00085" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00085">[SWS_Ea_00085]</a>. Als erster Schritt von <code>NvM_ReadAll</code> wird über Block ID 1 die gespeicherte Konfigurations-ID mit der kompilierten Software-Konfigurations-ID verglichen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00034" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00034">[SWS_NvM_00034]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00073" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00073">[SWS_NvM_00073]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00246" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00246">[SWS_NvM_00246]</a>. Bei einer Übereinstimmung erfolgt die normale Vorbereitung aller Blöcke <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00247" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00247">[SWS_NvM_00247]</a>; bei Abweichung und aktiver dynamischer Konfiguration (<code>NvMDynamicConfiguration == TRUE</code>) greift eine erweiterte Laufzeitvorbereitung zur Wiederherstellung von Standardwerten <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00248" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00248">[SWS_NvM_00248]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00249" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00249">[SWS_NvM_00249]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00309" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00309">[SWS_NvM_00309]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00310" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00310">[SWS_NvM_00310]</a>. Für fabrikneue Steuergeräte steht mit <code>NvM_FirstInitAll</code> ein Initialisierungsdienst bereit, der Blöcke mit Standardwerten beschreibt oder invalidiert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_91001" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_91001">[SWS_NvM_91001]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00913" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00913">[SWS_NvM_00913]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00916" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00916">[SWS_NvM_00916]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00923" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00923">[SWS_NvM_00923]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00931" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00931">[SWS_NvM_00931]</a>.</p> <p>Beim Herunterfahren des Steuergeräts (Shutdown) stößt der <code>BswM</code> die Multiblock-Schreibfunktion <code>NvM_WriteAll</code> an <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00018" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00018">[SWS_NvM_00018]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00092" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00092">[SWS_NvM_00092]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00254" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00254">[SWS_NvM_00254]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00720" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00720">[SWS_NvM_00720]</a>. <code>NvM_WriteAll</code> schaltet die Speichergeräte bei Bedarf erneut in den Fast-Mode <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00430" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00430">[SWS_NvM_00430]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00431" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00431">[SWS_NvM_00431]</a> und synchronisiert alle permanenten RAM-Blöcke oder RAM-Spiegel, die als gültig und verändert (valid/changed) markiert sind, mit den korrespondierenden NV-Blöcken <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00252" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00252">[SWS_NvM_00252]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00472" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00472">[SWS_NvM_00472]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00682" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00682">[SWS_NvM_00682]</a>. Schreibgeschützte oder gesperrte Blöcke werden ohne Fehler übersprungen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00434" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00434">[SWS_NvM_00434]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00750" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00750">[SWS_NvM_00750]</a>. Soll das Herunterfahren abgebrochen werden, ruft der <code>BswM</code> <code>NvM_CancelWriteAll</code> auf, wodurch der aktuell geschriebene Block konsistent beendet und nachfolgende Blöcke als <code>NVM_REQ_CANCELED</code> markiert werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00019" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00019">[SWS_NvM_00019]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00232" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00232">[SWS_NvM_00232]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00236" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00236">[SWS_NvM_00236]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00238" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00238">[SWS_NvM_00238]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00703" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00703">[SWS_NvM_00703]</a>. Statusübergänge von Multiblock- und Einzelblockoperationen werden dem <code>BswM</code> über <code>BswM_NvM_CurrentJobMode()</code> und <code>BswM_NvM_CurrentBlockMode()</code> gemeldet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00745" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00745">[SWS_NvM_00745]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00746" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00746">[SWS_NvM_00746]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00888" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00888">[SWS_NvM_00888]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00889" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00889">[SWS_NvM_00889]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00890" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00890">[SWS_NvM_00890]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00891" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00891">[SWS_NvM_00891]</a>.</p> <h4>Fehlerbehandlung, Det-Tracing und Degradation</h4> <p>Zur Erkennung von Dateninkonsistenzen nutzt der Cluster mehrstufige Integritätsmechanismen. Für NV- und RAM-Blöcke können CRC-Prüfsummen konfiguriert werden, die über das Modul <code>Crc</code> in Einzelschritten innerhalb der <code>NvM_MainFunction</code> berechnet werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00040" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00040">[SWS_NvM_00040]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00164" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00164">[SWS_NvM_00164]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00165" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00165">[SWS_NvM_00165]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00180" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00180">[SWS_NvM_00180]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00212" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00212">[SWS_NvM_00212]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00333" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00333">[SWS_NvM_00333]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00334" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00334">[SWS_NvM_00334]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00466" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00466">[SWS_NvM_00466]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00571" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00571">[SWS_NvM_00571]</a>. Beim Lesen wird die CRC geprüft; bei aktiviertem Static Block ID Header wird zusätzlich geprüft, ob die gelesene Block-ID mit der angeforderten übereinstimmt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00523" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00523">[SWS_NvM_00523]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00524" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00524">[SWS_NvM_00524]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00580" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00580">[SWS_NvM_00580]</a>. Um Flash-Schreibzyklen zu minimieren, kann über <code>NvMBlockUseCRCCompMechanism</code> ein CRC-basierter Schreibvergleich aktiviert werden, der das Schreiben unveränderter Daten überspringt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00849" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00849">[SWS_NvM_00849]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00850" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00850">[SWS_NvM_00850]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00853" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00853">[SWS_NvM_00853]</a>.</p> <p>Bei Schreibfehlern führt der <code>NvM</code> automatische Wiederholversuche bis zur konfigurierten Grenze <code>NVM_MAX_NUM_OF_WRITE_RETRIES</code> durch <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00168" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00168">[SWS_NvM_00168]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00213" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00213">[SWS_NvM_00213]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00216" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00216">[SWS_NvM_00216]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00296" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00296">[SWS_NvM_00296]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00659" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00659">[SWS_NvM_00659]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00804" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00804">[SWS_NvM_00804]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00806" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00806">[SWS_NvM_00806]</a>. Nach erfolgreichem Schreiben kann optional ein schrittweiser Rücklese- und Verifikationsprozess stattfinden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00527" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00527">[SWS_NvM_00527]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00529" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00529">[SWS_NvM_00529]</a>. Bei Lesefehlern eines redundanten Blocks (z. B. CRC-Fehler oder Header-Fehler auf der ersten Instanz) liest der <code>NvM</code> automatisch die zweite NV-Kopie ein und stellt die verloren gegangene Redundanz wieder her <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00047" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00047">[SWS_NvM_00047]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00199" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00199">[SWS_NvM_00199]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00288" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00288">[SWS_NvM_00288]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00474" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00474">[SWS_NvM_00474]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00531" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00531">[SWS_NvM_00531]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00768" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00768">[SWS_NvM_00768]</a>. Schlagen alle NV-Leseversuche fehl, greift die Fehlerdegradation: Sofern konfiguriert, werden Standardwerte aus dem ROM-Block oder über den Callback <code>NvMInitBlockCallback</code> in das RAM geladen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00012" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00012">[SWS_NvM_00012]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00020" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00020">[SWS_NvM_00020]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00171" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00171">[SWS_NvM_00171]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00202" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00202">[SWS_NvM_00202]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00267" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00267">[SWS_NvM_00267]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00293" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00293">[SWS_NvM_00293]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00366" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00366">[SWS_NvM_00366]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00367" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00367">[SWS_NvM_00367]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00369" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00369">[SWS_NvM_00369]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00389" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00389">[SWS_NvM_00389]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00657" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00657">[SWS_NvM_00657]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00679" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00679">[SWS_NvM_00679]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00814" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00814">[SWS_NvM_00814]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00816" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00816">[SWS_NvM_00816]</a>. Existieren keine Standardwerte, bleibt der RAM-Block im Zustand <code>invalid</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00132" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00132">[SWS_NvM_00132]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00133" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00133">[SWS_NvM_00133]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00198" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00198">[SWS_NvM_00198]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00658" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00658">[SWS_NvM_00658]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00680" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00680">[SWS_NvM_00680]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00767" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00767">[SWS_NvM_00767]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00788" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00788">[SWS_NvM_00788]</a>.</p> <p>Fehlersituationen werden an das Diagnostic Event Manager (<code>Dem</code>) und Default Error Tracer (<code>Det</code>) gemeldet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00446" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00446">[SWS_NvM_00446]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00554" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00554">[SWS_NvM_00554]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_MemIf_00048" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_MemIf_00048">[SWS_MemIf_00048]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Fee_00104" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Fee_00104">[SWS_Fee_00104]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Ea_00098" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Ea_00098">[SWS_Ea_00098]</a>. Der <code>NvM</code> meldet definierte Produktionsfehler an das <code>Dem</code>: <code>NVM_E_INTEGRITY_FAILED</code> bei CRC-Fehlern oder <code>MEMIF_BLOCK_INCONSISTENT</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00203" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00203">[SWS_NvM_00203]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00294" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00294">[SWS_NvM_00294]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00653" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00653">[SWS_NvM_00653]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00677" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00677">[SWS_NvM_00677]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00779" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00779">[SWS_NvM_00779]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00790" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00790">[SWS_NvM_00790]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00864" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00864">[SWS_NvM_00864]</a>, <code>NVM_E_REQ_FAILED</code> bei Fehlschlagen von Aufträgen oder abgelaufenen Retries <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00302" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00302">[SWS_NvM_00302]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00305" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00663">[SWS_NvM_00663]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00666" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00666">[SWS_NvM_00666]</a>, <a href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00684">[SWS_NvM_00684]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00865" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00865">[SWS_NvM_00865]</a>, <code>NVM_E_WRONG_BLOCK_ID</code> bei fehlerhafter Static Block ID <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_NvM_00593" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_NvM_00593">[SWS_NvM_00593]</a>, <a
